{3: 'A small steam train rolls across the open southern plains, tracing the narrow tracks. The clatter of wheels against iron is drawn out by the wind, and it fades into the pale expanse of the countryside.'}

{3: 'It is a small, scenic looping line built long ago, well-preserved due to the barely inhabited area. A recreation of "The Colonel", the train has an engine and a single car, its cab just big enough for two to stand side by side.'}
{3: 'During your last visit to her underground film museum, Helentine mentioned that she would take you on this train one day.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'The train is moving. Hold on, Commandant.', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6001_08.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6001_08.jpg', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The whistle sounds. Outside, the field ridges begin to slide away, and the wind rushes in through the window, carrying with it the smell of grass and earth.'}
{3: 'Hills trace the skyline in the distance, while farmland and forest take turns sweeping past in the foreground.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'How are you feeling, Commandant?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The view is beautiful.', 3: '26', 4: 'The train is running smoothly.', 5: '28'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: '...The southern countryside of the Transatlantic has a charm all its own. I wanted to share it with you.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "I was a little worried at first. The train hasn't run in so long, so I thought it might be a bumpy ride.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: "The car sways gently as the train rounds a bend. Helentine's shoulder brushes against your arm."}
{3: 'Her gaze stays fixed on the window, but her fingers have quietly found the handrail and hold on. Every now and then, she steals a glance at the old mechanical clock on the wall.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Before there is even time for you to take it all in, the train begins to slow. Ahead, the platform you departed from comes back into view.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'End of the line.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Disable'}
{3: 'The train comes to a full stop, but Helentine does not move. Her hand still rests on the throttle, and her gaze drifts to somewhere distant ahead.'}
{3: 'The idle hum of the engine travels up through the floor, fine and constant like a pulse.'}
{2: "I'm still not quite ready for it to be over.", 3: '57'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "You were looking inward from the line the whole time, and it wasn't exactly the best view.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'How about we swap spots and go around once more?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: '...We were going a little fast too. If we go slower, I can tell you about the train itself as well.', 4: '1'}
{3: "You switch places. Squeezing past each other in the narrow cab, you are close enough to feel the warmth of each other's skin. The train starts up again."}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront52.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiSummerSign/FxUiSummerSignSun01.prefab', 2: '2'}

{3: 'You look outward, and the view opens up. Afternoon light spills across the fields, where corn and sunflowers weave together in alternating patches. Further out, the cream-colored walls of farmhouses gleam in the sun.'}
{2: 'This side catches more sun, and the wheat fields are brighter.', 3: '71'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Helentine talks more this time. She mentions she tracked down this route herself, which took her quite a while. Moving the train here from underground was no small feat either.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront52.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiSummerSign/FxUiSummerSignSun01.prefab'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Loop'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: '"The Colonel" was an extraordinarily expensive production for its time, filled with dangerous stunts...', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Helentine talks through a few scenes from "The Colonel", her gaze drifting between the window and the throttle as she speaks. Perhaps because she is talking about her interest, she seems more relaxed than usual.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Before either of you realizes it, the platform appears ahead of you for the second time.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Disable'}
{3: 'The train slows.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Commandant, there's actually more to see along this route—", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She gradually moves her hands away from the throttle, and they fall to her side.'}
{3: 'The cab turns silent, save for the low rumble of the idling engine and the faint chorus of insects drifting in from the fields.'}
{2: 'Is there... something you want to tell me?', 3: '102'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'You came all this way, Commandant. I can only imagine how much went into making that happen.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'And yet there was so little I could do in return. It just feels... not enough.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The words barely leave her lips before her fingers curl slowly into the fabric of her skirt, and she lowers her head.'}
{2: 'The scenery, the train, and everything you told me...', 3: '109'}
{2: "All of it shows how much effort you've put in today.", 3: '110'}
{3: 'She looks up.'}
{2: 'I feel it all. How could that ever not be enough?', 3: '114'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: '【kuroname】...', 4: '1'}
{2: "There's so much more we can do when we're together.", 3: '117'}
{3: 'You reach down and take her hand. Her fingers go still for a moment before relaxing one by one, folding around your hand and holding it firmly.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'I see.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1320.jpg', 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Loop'}
{3: 'The train moves once more. Dusk approaches, and the view of the fields gradually changes in the fading light.'}
{3: 'The twilight turns the fields dark gold. Helentine and you stand shoulder to shoulder in the narrow cab, your fingers laced together.', 17: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg3Shake2Disable'}

{2: 'The twilight turns the fields dark gold. Helentine and you stand shoulder to shoulder in the narrow cab, your fingers laced together. As the train returns to the station, the bell chimes, and you stand a little closer.'}
{3: 'As the train returns to the station, the bell chimes, and you stand a little closer.', 22: '1', 23: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'As if suddenly remembering something, Helentine pulls out her terminal and opens the camera.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Look at the camera, Commandant?', 4: '1'}
{2: '(Strike a pose)', 3: '148', 4: '(Pull her in for a photo together)', 5: '155'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Commandant, you look wonderful.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Let me take a few of you, too.', 3: '152'}
{3: 'Helentine looks a little stiff in front of the camera at first, but she starts to loosen up after a few shots, striking poses you never would expect to see from her.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: '...Alright. Together.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Helentine faces the camera, her eyes wavering, but she leans in closer anyway.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: "The photo captures Helentine's rare, unguarded expression perfectly."}

{3: 'You take more photos afterward: fields blurring past the window, the warm glow of the setting sun across the carriage, and the unguarded expressions neither of you can hide. All of them are collected into a little screen.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'I want to record all of them: the scenery, the time we spend together...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "It's something... we can do together.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}

{3: 'The train presses on along the narrow tracks. The same scenery is somehow different every time, shaped by whoever is there to see it. The sun sinks slowly behind the distant hills, and your shadows rest side by side.'}
{3: 'The day is far from over. There is still so much you can do together.'}
